title: Let go vet find the bugs
hints: Run the tests and read the first lines of output. They come from vet, e.g. `Sprintf format %d has arg kind of wrong type string`.
In `Summary` the verbs are in the wrong order for the arguments. Verbs are matched to arguments left to right.
A literal percent sign in a format string is written `%%`, so the format becomes `"%.1f%%"`.
